summary: Adds a new experimental CAM_Flute operation (ramping slot/groove along a face centerline or flat 2D wire) with its own task panel, properties (FlutingType, RampType, RampLengthType, RampLength, RampLengthPercent, FlipStart2D, FlippedSegments, ReverseDirection, BlindEndCompensation, CombineTangentSegments, AxialStockToLeave), dropdown icons, and a selection gate, grouped in the Engrave toolbar/menu group behind the experimental-features preference.
